slides.photo_prompt: Photorealistic lifestyle photo, vertical 4:5. A Korean woman in her 20s at a bright bedroom window on an early winter morning, face out of frame, opening sheer white curtains with one hand while holding a clear glass of water in the other, wearing a cozy knit cardigan, a simple alarm clock on the nightstand and a neatly folded outfit on a chair blurred in the background, gentle sunrise light. Soft peach and cream color palette, soft natural light, clean minimal set, shallow depth of field, editorial beauty magazine style. No text, no logos, no product packaging, no pills or medicine, no before-and-after, no visible skin conditions.

slides.title: [[Late nights]] add up
slides.body: Holiday plans and year-end work often push bedtime later. Then the alarm rings before you're ready, and every minute feels short.

slides.title: Deciding [[on the spot]]
slides.body: Picking an outfit, breakfast and a skincare order all at once takes time. A morning with no plan tends to feel more rushed.

slides.kicker: Pick your A, B or C
slides.title: Glow's [[5-min]] routine

items.head: A. Water before coffee
items.sub: A glass of water as soon as you wake

items.head: B. Wash, then moisturize
items.sub: Lukewarm water and one simple layer

items.head: C. Open the curtains
items.sub: A minute of daylight and a stretch
